s1.syndrome_frame: Upper gastrointestinal bleeding with a gastric mass and anemia
salient_findings: Heterogeneous mass with fat attenuation and internal septations on CT
key_facts: Approximately 1 year of upper gastrointestinal bleeding
No prior evaluations
Referred for upper endoscopy
Large antral mass found on endoscopy
Mucosal biopsy was obtained
Patient declined endoscopic ultrasound initially
Patient was lost to follow-up during pregnancy
Returned with ongoing anemia and new epigastric pain
Repeat esophagogastroduodenoscopy with endoscopic ultrasound identified a 6 cm mass
Mass arose from the muscularis propria of the gastric antrum
CT scan showed a 9.7 × 7.8 × 4.8 cm heterogeneous mass
Mass was adherent to the posterior wall of the gastric antrum
Mass had predominantly fat attenuation and internal septations
No pathologic lymphadenopathy found on CT
Patient presented with melena
Repeat endoscopy showed mucosal ulceration overlying the mass
Biopsy results were consistent with adipose tissue

shortlist.label: Gastric lipoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass had predominantly fat attenuation and biopsy results were consistent with adipose tissue

shortlist.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Large antral mass found on endoscopy and mass arose from the muscularis propria of the gastric antrum

shortlist.label: Leiomyoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass arose from the muscularis propria of the gastric antrum and no pathologic lymphadenopathy found on CT

shortlist.label: Liposarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass had predominantly fat attenuation, but lack of aggressive features makes this less likely

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass arose from the muscularis propria of the gastric antrum, but absence of clear malignant features makes this less likely

raw.rationale: The mass had predominantly fat attenuation and internal septations on CT scan, and biopsy results were consistent with adipose tissue, which are characteristic features of a gastric lipoma.

rejected.label: Gastrointestinal stromal tumor
rejected.why: Gastrointestinal stromal tumors typically do not have predominantly fat attenuation on CT scan.

rejected.label: Leiomyoma
rejected.why: Leiomyomas are typically solid masses without significant fat attenuation.

rejected.label: Liposarcoma
rejected.why: Liposarcomas are malignant tumors that would likely show more aggressive features such as pathologic lymphadenopathy, which was not found in this case.

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: Leiomyosarcomas are malignant tumors that would likely show more aggressive features such as pathologic lymphadenopathy, which was not found in this case.
